text:
Alex Tan: Hey everyone — day 1! SSO worked but when I try to open Console -> Admin Panel or the Feature Flags page I get a 403. I can access docs and the general Console home.
Priya S.: welcome Alex :tada: Usually a 403 on those paths means your org/team tag isn't attached for prod/staging scopes. Which environment did you sign up for (staging or prod)?
Alex Tan: staged for now — `platform-infra` workspace. I only need staging access to demo a private deployment + try the infra toolchain.
Noah: @Priya S. fyi we had a similar case yesterday where the SSO provisioner set wrong SCIM attrs. Alex, can you paste the URL you hit?
Alex Tan: https://console.redwood.ai/admin/flags (after SSO redirect).
InfraBot: Access helpers -> Submit an access request in #access-requests: choose "Console: staging-admin" or "SSH/KMS: staging" template. Expected TTL: 8-24h.
Ravi: For a quicker unblock, drop your public key in the infra portal and request a scoped KMS role. Steps: 1) generate key `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C \"alex@redwood.ai\"` 2) paste pubkey at https://internal.redwood/tools/infra-portal -> SSH keys 3) open `KMS (staging)` request and include reason + demo time.
Lina M.: If you want same-day access, I can request a 2-hour "just-in-time" session with ops once you file the KMS ticket. DM me the REQ number.
Alex Tan: thanks — pasted pubkey and filed request REQ-6721 (env=staging, team=platform-infra, timeframe=Mar 28 10:00-12:00 UTC). Also added screenshot of 403.
Priya S.: I added a note to REQ-6721 to attach `team:platform-infra` mapping. Ops will approve the scoped role; you should then be able to hit /admin/flags.
Noah: Quick note — if it still 403s after approval, try clearing SSO cookies or open in incognito (old session sometimes keeps missing claims).
Alex Tan: got it, thanks everyone! I'll DM Lina once REQ-6721 is approved to schedule the jumpbox. :slightly_smiling_face:
Lina M.: welcome aboard — ping when ready and Ill queue the session.
Ravi: tagging infra-runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/access-provisioning for future reference.
Alex Tan: appreciated — closing loop once I can access flags. :+1:
